## Publication Information

**Date:** 1870

**Genre:** Fiction (by others)

**Publisher:** London and New York: Macmillan and Co

**Notes:** This was an anthology of reprinted eighteenth- and early nineteenth-century children’s stories by various hands;  a second series appeared in 1872.  The stories were ‘The History of Philip Quarll’,  ‘The Renowned History of little Goody Two-Shoes’, ‘The Governess, or, The Little Female Academy’, ‘Jemima Placid, or, The advantage of good-nature’, ‘The Life and Perambulations of a Mouse’, ‘The Village School’, ‘The Little Queen’ and ‘The History of little Jack’.
